answer: A legislature votes on whether to repair a beacon whose power-supply ripple degrades its radio signal. The election authority issues each elected district representative a credential bound to the district and round, after checking certified election returns and identity. Representatives sign ballots; validators check signatures and count each district once, rejecting invalid or repeated credentials, including reissues. An extra vote requires winning another district or persuading its representative. This trusts the election and identity checks; representatives can sell influence.
